title: Check failed in DocDB compaction filter on distributed transaction metadata
body:
When DocDB compaction happens and encounters a key for distributed transaction metadata, check fails and the compaction aborts:

    Key (best-effort decoded): "\x0ax2y\xa4\xc6\xe4\xc9O\xad\x8e\x8d\x87\xde\x9a\xbbj\xfc"
